issue.title: SQLite
issue.body:
The app will need to store data locally. Using SQLite is a well-known, robust, and supported way of doing this.

This ticket expects the following:
- select SQLite lib to use (e.g. libsql, expo-sqlite, etc.)
- install it into the project
- create a demo page to demonstrate a basic CRUD

comments.body:
1. Platform familiarization                       - (ET 4hrs)
2. Research SQLite lib                            - (ET 3hrs)
3. Going through the documentations     - (ET 3 hrs)
4. Install it into the project                       -  (ET 1hr)
5. Create a demo page to  demonstrate - (ET 3hrs)
